extracted.summary: A solicitor at Thackeray Solicitors LLP asks whether funding of £38,000 for disbursements and counsel is available for a client's commercial contract dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details provided so far. To consider it further we would need confirmation of the nature of the matter, the jurisdiction in which proceedings are taking place, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, and the value and nature of any assets available as security. It would also help to have your client's details and confirmation of your firm's continued instruction. Please note that Lodestar Legal Finance's products are the Family Law Loan and the Probate Loan, and nothing in this message should be taken as an indication that funding will be offered. We will come back to you once we have reviewed the information.
